mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets Alloy assign an application's applicant as its own assigned officer — the conflict-of-interest violation FR-011 forbids. No other fact enforces applicant != assignedOfficer at the application level.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssign { some a: LoanApplication | some a.assignedOfficer and a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets a successful state-changing operation exist with no audit entry and lets orphan audit entries exist that no operation produced — exactly the audit-completeness and append-only violations.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some op: Operation | op.succeeded = BTrue and op.kind = PatchStatus and no op.produces }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets one applicant hold two simultaneous in-flight applications, violating the FR-008 partial-unique-index rule from data-model.md.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlight { some disj a1, a2: LoanApplication | a1.applicant = a2.applicant and a1.status = Pending and a2.status = Pending }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows a user to hold both officer and auditor at once, which FR-002 explicitly forbids; no other fact rules out the combination.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OfficerAndAuditor { some u: User | ROfficer in u.roles and RAuditor in u.roles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets an unauthorised authenticated GET return a non-NotFound response (e.g., Forbidden), leaking that the application exists — exactly the FR-020/021/022 byte-equivalence breach.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakResp { some op: Operation | some op.caller and op.kind = GetApplication and op.succeeded = BFalse and op.response = ForbiddenResp }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact lets an applicant-only caller successfully GET an application they don't own and aren't an officer for, violating ownership-conditional read access (FR-003).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossRead { some op: Operation | op.succeeded = BTrue and op.kind = GetApplication and some op.caller and op.caller.roles = RApplicant and op.caller != op.target.applicant and op.caller != op.target.assignedOfficer }
